name: CHLOROPYRAMINE 20MG/2ML INJECTABLE SOLUTION 5 AMPOULES
description: Chloropyramine 20 mg/2 ml injectable solution, available in a 5-ampoule presentation, is a first-generation antihistamine used to treat various acute allergic reactions, such as allergic rhinitis, conjunctivitis, and bronchial asthma, in adults and children over 5 years of age. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
